messages:
Maya: planning a small rewrite of the starter initializer quickstart to simplify first deploy + fix auth samples. PR in ~30m.
Jonah: are we standardizing on REDWOOD_KEY or keeping REDWOOD_API_KEY?
Maya: keep REDWOOD_API_KEY for now for backward compat, but will add migration snippet and mention REDWOOD_KEY legacy usage.
Eli: can the Node example use SDK v4 call pattern? folks still copy v3 style.
Maya: yes converting Node to v4 and adding a sync-mode Python example. snippet:
```
// Node SDK v4 minimal
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood/text-lite', prompt: 'Hello world' })
```
Samir: prefer text-lite for latency. add parenthetical about cost/latency tradeoffs.
Maya: done; changed to text-lite and added a short note.
Jonah: add a docker env var note about ARG vs ENV, people flip that.
Maya: adding Docker snippet and a comment about buildtime vs runtime:
```
# Dockerfile (example)
ARG REDWOOD_API_KEY
ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY} # pass at build or use runtime secrets
```
Eli: link the auth migration guide in the PR description, reviewers will ask.
Maya: linked to /docs/migrations/auth-keys in the PR.
Samir: fix the quickstart footer link too, it points to an old docs host.
Maya: fixed, force-pushed, added a tiny linter that checks code block rendering.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview created — https://deploy-preview-5423--docs.redwood.ai
Jonah: preview renders cleanly, lgtm :thumbsup:
Maya: will merge after one more approval, tagging docs-reviewers now.
